sloka: अयुक्तं तु कपिश्रेष्ठ मम गन्तुं त्वया ऽनघ ।वायुवेगसवेगस्य वेगो मां मोहयेत्तव ।। ५.३७.४३।।।।
transliteration: ayuktaṁ tu kapiśreṣṭha mama gantuṁ tvayā 'nagha ।vāyuvegasavegasya vego māṁ mohayettava ।। 5.37.43।।।।

translations.english: "I know you are capable of carrying me on your journey. I am sure about the quick success of your mission which has been carried out after careful planning.
